rows.en: But he himself had no interest whatsoever in such things,
and later set off to wander space alone, but that is another story.
Meanwhile, the Macross 7 fleet,
though Battle 7 was heavily damaged in the fight with the Protodeviln,
journeyed on through space, once more seeking a new planet to settle.
rows.notes: Prefill started 'it journeyed on'; the subject is the Macross 7 fleet named in u1044, so 'it' dropped.

rows.en: And then, taking leave of the Macross 7 fleet, its battles now over,
rows.notes: Japanese gives no subject for leaving the fleet; continued with 'they' in u1048 (presumably the player and partner).

rows.en: they moved to a new colony fleet and set out toward the galactic center...
rows.notes: Subject 'they' supplied; the Japanese has none. Presumably the player and partner (no %s in this epilogue).

rows.en: The Vajra Queen fell, and the Vajra, command in chaos, began to flee.
The crisis of the Vajra's unprecedented all-out attack had passed.
But whether the Vajra threat had now
been completely removed, no one could say.
Where the Vajra had come from in the first place, and for what purpose,
or whether they were bioweapons someone made; unknowns abounded.
And of course, space was full of unknown dangers besides the Vajra.
Even so, pressing on toward the center of the galaxy,
the Macross Frontier's voyage is not over yet.
And so,
for %s and %s,
the fighting, too, is likely not over yet...
